headword: ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}

definitions.explanation: A Japanese tax system that allows individuals to make donations to local governments of their choice in exchange for tax deductions and regional specialty gifts in return.

examples.japanese: ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a hometown tax donation.

examples.japanese: ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返礼品|へんれいひん}→返礼品：20278_henreihin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received rice as a return gift from the hometown tax program.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Applications for the hometown tax donation program increase toward the end of the year.

notes:
FORMS:
ふるさと (hometown) + ⟦{納税|のうぜい}→納税：13806_nouzei⟧ (tax payment)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Introduced in 2008 to help revitalize rural areas by allowing taxpayers to redirect a portion of their taxes to local governments outside their place of residence. Despite the name, it functions as a donation system rather than a direct tax. Donors receive ⟦{返礼品|へんれいひん}→返礼品：20278_henreihin⟧ (return gifts) — typically regional specialties like meat, seafood, rice, or fruit — making it popular as a way to get local products while reducing taxes. Applications peak in December as people rush to make donations before the tax year ends.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返礼品|へんれいひん}→返礼品：20278_henreihin⟧: return gift from hometown tax
- ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}む→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧: to apply for hometown tax
- ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧: hometown tax donation website
